title: Banking Hall, 20 Main Street, Athboy, Co. Meath
seoTitle: Banking Hall, 20 Main Street, Athboy, Co. Meath
description:
Herbert and Lansdowne are honoured to bring this outstanding ground floor flat in this stunning historical building to the letting market.  This property has been completely refurbished from its original use as a bank and separated into three completely different rental spaces internally.

The building was formerly an Ulster Bank which ceased trading in 2015 and is 100 years old. While the owners have put a modern twist with pure elegance on the refurbishment they have kept some of the exceptional historical features like the high ceilings and fireplaces.  In total there are 3 apartments in the entire building which extends to 3500 sq. ft in totality. which have access to a private court yard / garden to enjoy on the sunny days.

The main bank hall apartment to let consists of two bedrooms, En-suite bathroom, family bathroom, large living room and a vibrant galley style equipped kitchen with all modern conveniences. The property is heated with electric heating with feature cast iron radiators.
There is the added security of CCTV cameras to the front and rear of the property and the broadband provider is currently Sky. On street parking is free and does not require permits.

ATHBOY is less than an hour's commute at peak to the M50, the Blanchardstown industrial estates and less than an hour to Dublin Airport off peak. It is a thriving community with a host of nearby shops, pubs and restaurants. There is also a direct bus route to Dublin city centre and it is within commuting distance to Cavan, Dundalk & Maynooth. You also have the neighbouring towns of Navan and Dunshaughlin, all within half an hour commute. 

Please contact us today by email to register your interest to view this stunning, unique property.
